notes.title: Update on development and small Christmas Q&A with Infinity Area (in French)
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I hope you're all doing well and that you survived this past year. 

The development for Derelicts has been going steady and I've been working a lot on optimization during the first semester, and focused a lot on rewriting code and cleaning up my project for the second part, so I can start the real world building and focus on the core gameplay mechanics. 

I'm really excited to start this phase as I'll have a lot more to show for in the coming months.

Together with Florian, a friend working on the website Infinity Area, we made a small written Q&A (that one was in French only so be sure to use your favorite translator) that you can find at the following link:

https://infinity-area.com/article/interview-exclusive-sur-le-jeu-derelicts-un-jeu-de-survie

I wish you all a Merry Christmas with family and friends.

I'll see you in 2025 with more content and updates!

Romain

notes.title: July Recap!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! I’m Jordan from Hashtag Survival, here to help Romain keep you updated on Derelict’s progress and take some load off his plate. Last month was packed with updates: we released a two-part Q&A series, published a short video highlighting the tree chopping mechanic, and (though it’s a day late, we’re counting it as July) here’s a video of Romain showcasing his progress and giving you a peek at a slice of the world so far.

[b]We’ll see you at the end of the month with more news and the next recap.[/b] Don’t forget to sign up for a free [url=patreon.com/Derelicts]Patreon[/url] account to get alerts when things are posted, or come hang out in the [url=https://discord.gg/K3s983u2Jr]Discord[/url] if that’s more your style!

notes.title: Some more screenshots of what I've been working on recently!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Here is a quick update to let you know I'm still alive and kicking, working on Derelicts!

Enjoy some screenshots I took while working!

- Some new enemies I added.
- A base players will be able to furnish and make is as cozy as they want to.
- Wildlife
- Mechanics like log flumes and wind turbines

I wish you a great week!

Romain
